rs1801131.sentence: rs1801131 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.

DPYD*5.sentence: DPYD*5 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
DPYD*5.explanation: The paper focused on DPYD rs1801265 and referenced other DPYD variants only generally; no DPYD*5-specific analyses or results were presented.

rs45445694.sentence: Genotypes 2R/2R + 2R/3R of rs45445694 are not associated with increased severity of hematological adverse reactions during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to genotype 3R/3R.
rs45445694.explanation: Although TYMS rs45445694 (TSER 2R/3R) was genotyped, the retrospective nested case-control study of 82 patients did not report a significant association with ADRs by logistic regression.

rs1045642.sentence: rs1045642 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs1045642.explanation: While an ABCB1 variant appeared in a multivariate anemia model (and was not statistically significant), the specific rs1045642 SNP was not analyzed or reported.

rs717620.sentence: rs717620 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs717620.explanation: ABCC2 rs717620 was cited from another Chilean study as part of prior evidence, but it was not analyzed in this cohort.

DPYD*13.sentence: DPYD*13 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
DPYD*13.explanation: The study referenced DPYD genotyping broadly but did not test or report results for DPYD*13 in the 82-patient cohort.

rs9561778.sentence: rs9561778 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs9561778.explanation: This variant was not included among those analyzed or discussed in the study’s results.

rs1695.sentence: Allele A of rs1695 is associated with increased risk of hematological and nervous system adverse reactions during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to allele G.
rs1695.explanation: In this 82-patient study, GSTP1 rs1695 showed that the A allele conferred higher risk of hematological and nervous system ADRs by logistic regression; the cohort received FP-based regimens (e.g., FOLFOX/FOLFIRI/CAPOX/capecitabine).

rs11280056.sentence: Allele 6-bp deletion of rs11280056 is associated with decreased risk of gastrointestinal and hematological adverse reactions during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to the insertion allele.
rs11280056.explanation: The study found the TYMS 3′UTR 6-bp deletion (rs11280056) to be protective against GI and hematological ADRs in the 82-patient Chilean cohort using logistic regression.

rs55886062.sentence: rs55886062 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs55886062.explanation: The canonical DPYD toxicity variant (DPYD*13; rs55886062) was not evaluated in this cohort; only rs1801265 was analyzed among DPYD SNPs.

rs1044642.sentence: rs1044642 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs1044642.explanation: The paper did not report analyses for rs1044642; ABCB1 SNPs were not individually specified.

rs67376798.sentence: rs67376798 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs67376798.explanation: The DPYD c.2846A>T variant (rs67376798) was not analyzed in the study; it was only discussed that some DPYD variants were not included.

rs1801133.sentence: Allele C of rs1801133 is associated with increased risk of nervous system adverse reactions and decreased likelihood of pain during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to allele T.
rs1801133.explanation: The study reported MTHFR rs1801133 C allele linked to higher nervous-system ADR risk but protective against pain in the 82-patient cohort; associations were derived from logistic regression.

rs1128503.sentence: rs1128503 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs1128503.explanation: Although ABCB1 variation was referenced within a multivariate model, rs1128503 was not specifically analyzed or reported.

rs6737679.sentence: rs6737679 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.

rs11479.sentence: Allele T of rs11479 is associated with increased likelihood of pain during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to allele C.
rs11479.explanation: The study found TYMP rs11479 (c.1412C>T) T allele associated with pain development in the 82-patient cohort via logistic regression.

rs16430.sentence: rs16430 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs16430.explanation: The TYMS 3′UTR 6‑bp variant was analyzed as rs11280056 in this study; rs16430 itself was not reported.

DPYD*9.sentence: Allele C of DPYD*9 (rs1801265) is associated with increased risk of neuropathy during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to allele T.
DPYD*9.explanation: The study specifically analyzed DPYD rs1801265 (DPYD*9A) and identified the C allele as a risk factor for neuropathies in the 82-patient cohort.

rs3742106.sentence: rs3742106 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs3742106.explanation: This variant was not included in the analyzed panel or reported in the results.

rs13181.sentence: Genotype CC of rs13181 is associated with decreased risk of gastrointestinal (gastric) adverse reactions during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to genotypes AA + AC.
rs13181.explanation: ERCC2 rs13181 (c.2251A>C) showed the CC genotype as a protective factor against gastric ADRs in this 82-patient study using logistic regression.

rs180131.sentence: rs180131 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.

rs3918290.sentence: rs3918290 mentioned in article but not studied by paper.
rs3918290.explanation: The canonical DPYD*2A splice variant (rs3918290) was not analyzed; only rs1801265 was genotyped among DPYD variants.

rs1801265.sentence: Allele C of rs1801265 is associated with increased risk of neuropathy during fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy in people with advanced colorectal cancer as compared to allele T.
rs1801265.explanation: In this retrospective nested case-control study of 82 Chilean advanced CRC patients, DPYD rs1801265 C allele was identified as a risk factor for neuropathies via logistic regression.
